# Codex brief — 11 new MAiVEN stained-glass portraits

**⚠️ SCOPE: images only.** Do NOT edit code, HTML, JSON, or run git. Output PNG image files only, to the exact paths below. One image per subject.

## Style lock (match the existing set exactly)
These must be indistinguishable in style from the current Maven portraits. Use these as the reference anchors:
- `assets/mavens/y2k-stained-glass-v2/fei-fei-li-y2k-stained-glass.png`
- `assets/mavens/y2k-stained-glass-v2/karen-sparck-jones-y2k-stained-glass.png`
- `assets/mavens/y2k-stained-glass-v2/grace-hopper-y2k-stained-glass.png`

Register: **Y2K illuminated stained-glass portrait** — a single dignified woman framed in a leaded-glass arch, jewel tones (plum #4b2148, gold #b49764, teal #5b8c92, rose #9b3f5f) with a warm gold halo/backlight, lead cames as flowing outlines, a soft radiant glow. Reverent but modern — the cathedral-of-heroes look, NOT baroque/fairytale. **Non-photoreal** — evocative of the person, not a photographic likeness. Each subject gets one small symbolic motif worked into the glass (below). **No text anywhere in the image.**

- Respectful, dignified, celebratory — these are real women being honored in a hall of heroes.
